“The Carolingians”, opening paragraphs and notes 35–37, 46: late testimony about 751, Boniface, and papal letters recalling the anointing of Pippin and his sons in 754.
“Un programme architectural voulu par les Carolingiens”, first two paragraphs: the basilica as the site of the 754 ceremony and later rebuilding under Fulrad.

Heading, opening and dating clause: 1 March 752, Verberie, rex Francorum. Narrative: Loba’s testament, Gislemar’s admission and surrender per festucam, Fulrad, and the preceding hearing before King Chilperic.

labels.de: Stephan II. salbt Pippin und seine Söhne
labels.en: Stephen II anoints Pippin and his sons

note.de: Papst Stephan II. salbte 754 in Saint-Denis Pippin und dessen Söhne Karl und Karlmann. Der Vater führte schon zuvor den Königstitel.
note.en: At Saint-Denis in 754 Pope Stephen II anointed Pippin and his sons Charles and Carloman. Their father was already using the royal title.
